notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Hi,

I've discovered some last-minute technical issues that make the online multiplayer unstable in some cases. Because of this, online multiplayer functionality won't be included in the game at launch.  I'm working on fixing this, and once things are stable enough, I'll add online multiplayer as an update.

Apologies for the inconvenience!

Cheers,
Vidak
